notes.title: Important Announcement: The Game's Title is Changing
notes.notes:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081577/3ad26a8ceda64c00f676c0b1201333d80fa40045.png"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p align="start"]As we reach the halfway point in development, the game has evolved significantly from its original concept. What began as a series of escape rooms has grown into a much deeper, narrative-driven experience.[/p][p align="start"]The original title, "Escape from Ivy & Piper," no longer reflects the core of the game.[/p][p align="start"]Effective immediately, the new title is [b]"Trapped with Ivy & Piper."[/b][/p][p align="start"]You will see all logos and promotional materials have now been updated to reflect this change. Please note: the in-game title itself will be updated in the next version release, scheduled in about two weeks.[/p][p align="start"]This wasn't a decision made lightly, but it's the right one for the project. The new title is a much better fit for three key reasons:[/p][list][*][p][b]It reflects the gameplay.[/b] The core experience is about being stuck in a situation with the characters, not actively escaping a room.[/p][/*][*][p][b]It's literal.[/b] The game begins with the main character physically trapped in a chair.[/p][/*][*][p][b]It's thematic.[/b] It hints at the deeper story, where Ivy and Piper are also emotionally "trapped" in their own lives.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]I wanted to share the reasoning for this change with you directly.[/p][p align="start"]Thanks for your support![/p][p align="start"]-Ace[/p]
